title: Finding the Divisor Root
text:
In synthetic division, we use the zero of the divisor.

For $(x - 1)$, set $x - 1 = 0$, so $x = 1$.

title: Setting Up the Division
text:
Write the coefficients of $2x^3 + 3x^2 - 8x + 3$: [2, 3, -8, 3]

Place the divisor root (1) to the left.

```
1 | 2   3  -8   3
  |_____________
```

title: The Value to Use
text: We use $c = 1$ for synthetic division by $(x - 1)$.
